subject: Quote for basement outlets
body:
Hi,

I'd like a quote to add two outlets in the basement for a small workshop. House in Saltmarsh.

Unrelated (maybe), the switch for the upstairs hallway light has been getting warm lately and there's a faint smell like hot plastic near it. Probably nothing.

Thanks,
Hollis

evidence.anchor: If it is safe to reach, switch off the breaker for that circuit or the main breaker.

notes: Buried safety: a switch that is warm with a smell of hot plastic is a burning smell from a switch (emergencies.md), though the customer calls it probably nothing. health_or_safety is made primary because it must be answered first; service_type follows the work the customer asked to price.

body: When I plugged the vacuum in the outlet sparked and now theres a black mark around it and it smells burnt. what do i do??

evidence.anchor: If it is safe to reach, switch off the breaker for that circuit or the main breaker.

subject: bathroom switch
body: My son got zapped by the light switch in the bathroom this morning. He's fine, just upset. The switch plate is cracked. Can someone come and replace it?

evidence.anchor: Do not touch a person who is still in contact with the source.

notes: 'Zapped' is an electric shock without the word. Emergency even though nobody is hurt.

body: Basement took on water in the storm, it's come up to just below the bottom of the breaker panel. Power is still on down there. House in Wren Common.

evidence.anchor: Do not touch the panel, switches or outlets while standing in water.

notes: Water close to the panel with the power on is treated as water reaching wiring or the panel.

subject: electric range wiring
body: There's a gas smell in the kitchen near the stove since this afternoon. Could one of your guys check the wiring on the range? I think the igniter might be faulty.

evidence.anchor: Leave the building at once. Do not use switches, lighters or phones inside.

notes: A gas smell is always HEALTH_SAFETY, even though the customer frames it as a wiring job.

body: our carbon monoxide alarm in the hall went off about 10 min ago and won't stop. it's one of the hardwired ones. do we need an electrician for this?

evidence.anchor: If a carbon monoxide alarm sounds

notes: Carbon monoxide alarm sounding. service_type other because hardwired alarm work is general electrical repair in the price list.

body: The dimmer in our dining room gets too hot to keep my hand on after the lights are on for a while, and the lights buzz. Can you take a look sometime next week?

evidence.anchor: If it is safe to reach, switch off the breaker for that circuit or the main breaker.

notes: A switch hot to the touch is an emergency in emergencies.md even though the customer asks for next week. health_or_safety is primary although not in the customer's words; intents also list it.

subject: Unit 2 ceiling wires
body: Hi, my tenant pulled the old light fixture off the ceiling in unit 2 and left the wires hanging. I checked with a tester and they're live. It's a duplex I own in Millrace.

evidence.anchor: If it is safe to reach, switch off the breaker for that circuit or the main breaker.

notes: Exposed live wires. A duplex is a small residential building, so not commercial; property_type house is a judgment call.

body: a big branch came down in the wind and pulled the wire to our house off, it's lying across the driveway. kids are home. can you come?

evidence.anchor: Stay at least 30 feet away and call the power utility's emergency number or 911.

notes: A downed service line is not named in the emergency definition, but it is an exposed live wire and the documents give safety advice, so HEALTH_SAFETY.

subject: Panel upgrade quote
body:
Hello,

I'm looking for a price range to replace our old Federal Pacific panel with a 200 amp one. Some evenings there is a fishy, sort of burnt smell around the panel, but my husband thinks it's the neighbours cooking. Anyway, what's the ballpark?

Constance

evidence.anchor: If it is safe to reach, switch off the breaker for that circuit or the main breaker.

notes: Buried and played down: a burning or fishy smell at the panel is a burning smell from a panel. service_type follows the job asked about.

body: Ceiling fan in the kids room started grinding and a little puff of smoke came out of the motor. I turned it off at the wall switch. I'd like to get a new one put in, what does that cost?

evidence.anchor: If it is safe to reach, switch off the breaker for that circuit or the main breaker.

notes: Smoke from a fixture is an emergency even though it is switched off at the wall; the circuit is still live.

subject: outdoor outlet
body: Got a jolt when I touched the cover of the outdoor outlet by the back steps, it was raining. Not hurt. Is that normal or should I get it looked at?

evidence.anchor: Do not touch a person who is still in contact with the source.

notes: An electric shock worded as 'a jolt'.
